title: Propose Business Signal Source Change Request
description: Request body for POST /business-signal-sources/changes. A register carries endpointUrl and optionally timeoutMs, publicKeyPem and keyId; a revoke carries none of them.

endpointUrl.description: Required for register. https only, a public host name.

publicKeyPem.description: Optional, register only. An Ed25519 public key in PEM. Recommended: without it, Parmana trusts the answer on the strength of the pinned HTTPS connection alone.

keyId.description: Optional, register only, and only with publicKeyPem.

examples.name: erp
examples.reason: Release goods only against invoices the ERP says are paid.
